name: [Equip] An edit has been waiting on translation too long
message:
Edits to a live course are being held back and cannot resolve on their own.

An edit to a published course waits until every language has it — that is deliberate, so readers never see a sentence whose other languages describe a different one. But a translation that failed its structural check does not retry itself (temperature 0 returns the same verdict), so the edit stays invisible to students indefinitely and the teacher sees nothing happen.

What to do:
* `GET /api/v1/courses/{id}/translation-progress` — `blocked_edits` and which locales.
* If the translation is actually fine and the checker misread it (short strings in two close languages are the usual case): `POST /api/v1/admin/translations/accept-reviewed` with the row ids.
* If it is genuinely wrong: fix the source text, which re-opens the field.
